description:
Planner node output. The trivial plan is the whole goal as the only subgoal; a direct
plan has no subgoals and its closing block alone is an accepted proof of the theorem.

hypotheses.description: Names the subgoals get in the skeleton (h1, h2, …)
hypotheses.title: Hypotheses

closing_source.description: `llm`, or `auto:<tactic>` when the model's closing failed and a tactic of planner.closing_auto closed the goal
closing_source.title: Closing Source

reason.description: Why the trivial plan was used (e.g. `refuted:sg2`), or `closing_auto:<tactic>` for a repaired closing
reason.title: Reason

skeleton_compiles.description: Skeleton compiles (sorry allowed) and the closing lemma is accepted (direct plan: the proof is accepted); None if not compiled
skeleton_compiles.title: Skeleton Compiles

title: Plan
